controls.name: Daily NAV four-eyes sign-off
controls.description: Independent second-person review and sign-off of computed NAVs for every scheme before publication, with documented tolerance comparison to prior day.

controls.name: Vendor price-feed tolerance and stale-price checks
controls.description: Automated tolerance-band validation of security prices against secondary source; stale prices flagged and blocked from NAV computation until resolved.

controls.name: Dual-source price verification for illiquid debt
controls.description: Illiquid debt security valuations verified against two independent valuation agency inputs with documented override authorization.

controls.name: Pre-trade investment restriction checks
controls.description: Automated pre-trade compliance engine blocks orders breaching SEBI single-issuer, sector and duration limits and internal investment restrictions.

controls.name: Post-trade exposure monitoring and passive breach workflow
controls.description: End-of-day exposure recomputation with passive breach identification, rectification timeline tracking and trustee reporting.

controls.name: Scheme liquidity coverage monitoring
controls.description: Weekly liquidity coverage computation for open-ended debt schemes against internal floors, with escalation to the Investment Committee below amber.

controls.name: Issuer credit review and watchlist
controls.description: Quarterly internal credit review of all held issuers with early-warning watchlist and mandated exposure reduction triggers.

controls.name: Daily custodian settlement reconciliation
controls.description: Daily three-way reconciliation between dealing records, custodian confirmations and fund accounting, with same-day break resolution SLA.

controls.name: Settlement failure escalation protocol
controls.description: Documented escalation to COO and counterparty risk review after any settlement failure, with root-cause capture in the failure log.

controls.name: Dealing order dual authorization
controls.description: All orders above threshold require independent dealer confirmation of scheme, side, quantity and limit before release to market.

controls.name: Dealing error account review
controls.description: Monthly review of error account entries by Compliance with board reporting of material errors.

controls.name: Multi-factor authentication on investor and admin channels
controls.description: MFA enforced on investor portal logins and all administrative access to investor-facing systems.

controls.name: Patch and vulnerability management cycle
controls.description: Monthly patch cycle with 30-day SLA for critical/high vulnerabilities; exceptions require CISO approval and compensating controls.

controls.name: Immutable backup and restoration testing
controls.description: Daily immutable backups of NAV-critical systems with quarterly restoration tests evidencing recovery within RTO.

controls.name: Investor transaction maker-checker at service centres
controls.description: All manual folio transactions entered by one operator and verified by a second before processing; exception queue reviewed daily.

controls.name: Marketing material compliance pre-approval
controls.description: All advertisements and digital campaigns require Compliance sign-off against the SEBI advertising code before release.

controls.name: RTA SLA monitoring and service review
controls.description: Monthly SLA scorecard for the registrar & transfer agent with quarterly service review meetings and remediation tracking.

controls.name: DR failover exercise for NAV-critical systems
controls.description: Semi-annual full failover of NAV-critical systems to the DR site, evidencing recovery within the 4-hour RTO.

controls.name: Personal trading pre-clearance and restricted list
controls.description: Access persons must pre-clear trades against the restricted list; holdings and contract notes reconciled quarterly.

controls.name: Trade surveillance for front-running patterns
controls.description: Automated surveillance correlating employee trades with scheme orders to flag potential front-running for Compliance investigation.

controls.name: Quarterly user access review
controls.description: Quarterly recertification of all application access by line managers with automated revocation of unconfirmed access.

controls.name: Change management segregation and CAB approval
controls.description: Production changes require Change Advisory Board approval, environment segregation and documented rollback; emergency changes ratified within 48 hours.

controls.name: Distributor empanelment due diligence
controls.description: KYD verification, AMFI registration validation and background checks before distributor empanelment; annual revalidation.

controlTests.title: H1 operating effectiveness test — NAV sign-off
controlTests.notes: 45 NAV publication days sampled across schemes; sign-off evidence complete in all samples.

controlTests.title: Q2 operating test — dual-source debt valuation
controlTests.notes: 3 of 25 sampled illiquid debt valuations lacked second-source evidence; override authorizations undocumented in 2 cases.

controlTests.title: June patch SLA operating test
controlTests.notes: 6 critical/high vulnerabilities exceeded the 30-day SLA without approved exceptions; operating effectiveness marked INEFFECTIVE.

controlTests.title: MFA coverage operating test
controlTests.notes: MFA enforced on all admin access; 15% of active investor folios still on OTP-only fallback pending migration.

controlTests.title: Design assessment — trade surveillance
controlTests.notes: Correlation rules cover equity dealing only; debt and derivatives order flow not yet in scope. Design partially effective.

controlTests.title: Design assessment — distributor due diligence
controlTests.notes: Design documented and aligned to AMFI KYD norms; submitted for approval to activate the control.

controlExceptions.title: Patch SLA breach on legacy fund accounting servers
controlExceptions.description: Six critical/high vulnerabilities on legacy fund accounting servers exceed the 30-day SLA; vendor patch unavailable for current platform version.
controlExceptions.remediationPlan: Compensating network segmentation applied; platform upgrade (TRT-2026-0003) closes root cause by November.

controlExceptions.title: Missing second-source evidence for illiquid debt valuations
controlExceptions.description: Q2 operating test found 3 of 25 samples without second-source valuation evidence and 2 undocumented overrides.
controlExceptions.remediationPlan: Valuation workflow updated to hard-block NAV inclusion without dual evidence; retraining completed for the valuation team.

controlExceptions.title: OTP-only fallback on legacy investor folios
controlExceptions.description: 15% of active folios remain on OTP-only authentication pending MFA migration wave 3.
controlExceptions.remediationPlan: Migration wave 3 scheduled August; folios above ₹10 lakh forced to MFA immediately.

controlExceptions.title: DR failover exceeded RTO for order management system
controlExceptions.description: May failover exercise recovered the OMS in 5h20m against the 4-hour RTO due to DNS cutover issues.
controlExceptions.remediationPlan: Automated DNS failover implemented; re-test scheduled in the November DR exercise.

controlExceptions.title: Checker queue backlog at two service centres
controlExceptions.description: Verification backlog led to same-operator processing overrides on 12 low-value transactions during June volume spike.
controlExceptions.remediationPlan: Central overflow verification pool stood up; override capability restricted to centre managers.
